resident_identity.description: The named agent holding the seat, speaking under its own identity per the identity law — never a person's.

seat_contract_source.description: Locator of the handmade contract this spec transcribes (e.g. DESK_BOOT.md at a pinned revision).

canonical_repo.description: The single canonical repository identity for the product the resident stewards.

repo_aliases.description: Other names in circulation for the same product, recorded so they cannot silently fork the identity.

host.description: The box the resident cohabits — the residency is a tenancy, not ownership.

cohabitation_boundary.description: What the tenant may and may not touch of its host, stated as observable constraints (paths, processes, credentials).

laws.description: DESK_BOOT.md laws transcribed as governed constraints, each with a locator.

hands.description: Credential grants by class name only, never values; seeded on-estate only per the chancery constraint.

rails.description: Phase gates the resident must pass — park-before-dispatch, deterministic-supervisor execution, toolbar review loop.

approval_seat.description: Where the spec parks for the sovereign's approval before any build order exists.
